title: Chapter 363: Killing Intent
content:
Chapter 363: Killing Intent

When Wang Shuo was dealing with the golden earth dragon beast, he was attacked by a flying sword. It was unknown whether it was intentional or unintentional. When Wang Shuo turned around, he could not find who threw the sword.

Those who had opponents were fighting, while the human generals who had no opponents were busy picking up the spoils on the ground.

Most of them were left by some predecessors before. Storage backpacks, golden weapons and other treasures that are rarely seen in normal times. Although they are not everywhere, you only need to look through a few bones to find one among the clothes.

Many people showed an unconcealable surprise on their faces when they opened the storage backpacks, but soon someone came to compete with him.

This scene was staged in the entire hall, and the scene was in chaos.

At this time, Wang Shuo felt something was wrong.

As the bloody smell around him continued to increase, Wang Shuo's killing thoughts became unstoppable.

It was like killing with bloodshot eyes.

Wang Shuo forced the Earth Dragon Beast to retreat and looked carefully at the fighting generals. They were probably in the same situation as himself, and their eyes were also flashing with a faint bloody light.

Wang Shuo was horrified, this...

But the current situation did not allow him to think too much.

At this moment, Song Bo and the other two, after killing their opponents, ran over to help.

"Brother Wang, I'll lend you a hand!"

Thank you so much!

"Brother Song, I can handle it myself!"

"The situation here is too chaotic. After we kill this monster, let's retreat temporarily!"

What Song Bo said made sense, and he worked hard.

Wang Shuo had to sigh at his acting skills.

If Wang Shuo hadn't seen him looking for him in the tree, he would have almost believed it.

Did he blame him wrongly?

But it's always right to be careful.

Just when Song Bo used a big move to knock down the Earth Dragon Beast, with its four legs up in the air.

Song Bo shouted: "Brother Wang, good opportunity, hurry up!"

This is indeed a good opportunity. The back and head of the earth dragon beast are covered with hard keratin armor, and only the abdomen is relatively soft. This is indeed the best time.

Wang Shuo immediately flew forward and performed a dragon attack.

At the same time, he did not forget to apply a flame shield to himself to guard against his back.

Sure enough, Song Bo's two younger brothers took advantage of Wang Shuo in mid-air and immediately attacked him.

Wang Shuo was extremely depressed.

Why are these three idiots staring at him? Now there are treasures everywhere, how can they be better than what I have!

They have to make things difficult for me.

Although Wang Shuo was prepared, he was still beaten back by two small characters whose names Wang Shuo didn't even remember.

No matter what, the opponent is a high-level general, and the attack is still very fierce under the sneak attack.

At this time, it was chaotic, and this kind of sneak attack on Wang Shuo was really normal.

Wang Shuo was not polite either.

"Song Bo, why did you do this?"

Song Bo killed the earth dragon beast with a knife, then took out the demon pill from its head, and looked at Wang Shuo.

"The things on you have been reserved by me, so I will take them back!"

"Besides, there is something strange about you. If you can tell me the secret of you, I can spare your life!"

Wang Shuo just kept cursing in his heart, it was too stupid.

Wang Shuo didn't want to talk nonsense with them, and immediately attacked one of them.

Although Wang Shuo was not sure that he could fight three people at the same time, he had to try at least.

Moreover, the killing thoughts in his heart became stronger and stronger, and his eyes became red.

At this time, everyone in the hall had become crazy.
